aboutpara: Welcome to my personal corner on the web! 🌐 My name is Nhat, a 20-year-old software engineering student at the University of Sydney.  This website serves as both a professional showcase of my journey and skills in software engineering and a creative outlet where I share my projects and ideas. 💡 Balancing my studies with my passion for technology, I often find myself immersed in coding and creating, exploring new technologies and methodologies that catch my eye. It's not just a portfolio; it's a platform where I document and share my creative pursuits, thanks to the ample time my curiosity affords me. ⏳||As you journey through this site, witnessing the milestones of my academic and creative endeavors, I hope you find pieces of my passion and dedication that resonate with you. I warmly welcome your thoughts, feedback, or even a simple hello. Thank you for visiting, and may you discover something here that sparks your own creativity and curiosity! ✨

resume.description: I have delivered world-class user experiences to millions of people. Well-versed with React, Javascript, and most of the Web frameworks.
